scope: Homemade affine selection/hoisting plus known private linear fingerprint control. Online receiver state shrinks, but a trusted factory retains large expanded fingerprints and does a full fresh canonical zero-C0 expansion per seed. Synthetic offsets are public algebra and never decrypted. All input/seed/epoch/lifetime binding is trusted local volatile state. Toy stages/counts are not large/GPU/native/RSS/transport/cold-bootstrap or production/parameter/KDM/private-timing assurance. No whole-system saving or original paper contribution claimed; factory role and private seed hints are not free.
